name.value: Comox Valley Horticultural Society Herb Garden

description.value: The Comox Valley Horticultural Society Herb Garden is a curated botanical attraction featuring a named collection of herbs with detailed taxonomic, historical, and medicinal descriptions, maintained by an active member-driven society in the Courtenay area of Vancouver Island. The CVHS is notably cycling-friendly, operating a dedicated 'Garden Cycling Tours' program — a self-guided 11 km bike route through downtown Courtenay gardens in partnership with the Comox Valley Cycling Coalition. The garden represents the society's educational mission and serves as a reference point for the region's broader garden-tourism network.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active herb garden operated by the Comox Valley Horticultural Society, with a detailed plant catalogue on the herb-garden page and a 2026 event calendar indicating the organization is current. No amenity information (bike parking, washrooms, potable water) is mentioned anywhere on the website for the herb garden itself; the open garden tour page does note 'restrooms will most likely not be available' for its tour locations, but that refers to private residences rather than this garden. The society explicitly runs 'Garden Cycling Tours' (Cycling the Garden Gate 2026), demonstrating strong cycling-community ties, though no physical address for the garden is given in OSM or on the website.
concerns: No physical street address for the herb garden in OSM or on the website — the only contact address is a P.O. Box (P.O. Box 3443, Station Main, Courtenay, BC V9N 5N5) for the society.
No phone number available in OSM or on the website.

Public access conditions for the herb garden are not described — unclear if it is independently open to walk-in visitors or only accessible during organised society events.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The herb garden is a legitimate public attraction managed by an active society with explicit cycling-tour programming, but no physical street address is confirmed, no cyclist amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are documented, and it is unclear whether the garden has fixed public access independent of organised events.
enrichment_extras.notes: The society's Garden Cycling Tours page (Cycling the Garden Gate 2026) documents a 11 km self-guided cycling route through Courtenay gardens, with the Comox Valley Cycling Coalition providing on-site advice and a suggested minimum donation benefiting local community organisations. This cycling program may be of independent interest for the WWC directory even if the herb garden itself lacks confirmed amenities.
